events.COLUMN_CHANGED: Columns created, renamed, moved or deleted
events.BOARD_CHANGED: Board created, renamed, archived or deleted
events.BOARD_SETTINGS_CHANGED: Labels, priority levels and board features changed

feed.goneChannel: a channel that no longer exists
feed.botCannotPost: The bot cannot post in #{channel}. Give it permission to view the channel and send messages there.
feed.pickOne: Pick at least one board; until then this feed covers every board.
feed.overrides: Boards with their own settings for this feed: {boards}. Change them in each board's settings.
feed.interactiveHint: Each post shows the whole task with buttons to move it, assign people, edit or follow it, right there in Discord.
feed.mentionRolesHint: Off by default: a role can be a lot of people. Mentioning people above only mentions individual people.

channel.gone: A channel that no longer exists

mine.unlessPinged: Only if I was not already mentioned
mine.unlessPingedHint: No direct message when a server update channel you can see already mentioned you for the same thing.
mine.alwaysHint: A direct message even if a channel mentioned you too.
mine.neverHint: No direct messages from the bot.
mine.serverAssignments: Only when I am assigned or unassigned
mine.intro: The bot can send you direct messages about tasks you are assigned to, created or follow. You are never told about your own changes, and only about boards you can see.
mine.followedHint: Follow a task from its panel, or with Follow in Discord, to hear about it like your own.
mine.commentedHint: Hear about tasks you took part in, not only ones you are assigned to or created.
mine.noServers: You are not in any server with the bot yet.

server.intro: The bot can post about this server in Discord. People can also get direct messages about their own tasks; they choose that themselves in their settings, and are never messaged about something a feed already mentioned them for.
server.noChannels: The bot has not reported this server's channels yet. They appear once the bot is running an up-to-date version and can see the channels.
server.auditHint: Every change, as in the audit log here. Never mentions anyone.
server.auditSaveFailed: The audit channel could not be saved
server.feedsHint: Each feed posts chosen changes to a channel, for every board or only some. Changes to the same task within half a minute are posted together.
server.feedSaveFailed: The feed could not be saved
server.feedAddFailed: The feed could not be added
server.feedDeleteFailed: The feed could not be deleted
server.deleteConfirm: The bot stops posting these updates. Messages it already posted stay.
